description: A Large, quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. You decide its appearance, and it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle; that equipment vanishes if carried more than 10 feet from the steed. For the duration, you or a creature you choose can ride the steed. The steed uses the Riding Horse stat block, except it has a Speed of 100 feet and can travel 13 miles in an hour. When the spell ends, the steed gradually fades, giving the rider 1 minute to dismount. The spell ends early if the steed takes any damage.
name: Phantom Steed
